i<=mid ; i++)\n        {\n            int start = queries[i][0];\n            int end = queries[i][1];\n            int value = queries[i][2];\n            //difference array ka creation\n            diff_array[start] += value;\n            if(end + 1 < diff_array.size())\n            {\n                diff_array[end + 1] -= value;\n            }\n        }\n            // cumulative sum\n            for(int i = 1 ;
